publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper discusses the smart cities in India and its features with the Smart City Mission and its strategy on state-wise basis considering its dimensions, duration, finances and challenges. The dimensions of smart cities and its empirical features are acknowledged and discussed. Then study the smart cities of India regarding its critical aspects such as function, features, technologies and its development stages. A comparison is made and then bring forth the problems of smart cities and how it can be tackled. Specific issues are discussed with a conclusion for its future prospect. With all the analysed data, the future scope of smart cities is discussed. All the work is for finding better ways to transform the digital cities of India.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Framework for Mitigating the Risk in eCommerce Websites
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: There is numerous use of web-based business in publicizing and advancing of items and administrations. Social business is a web-based business which utilizes web-based life structure connection among big businesses and buyers. This incorporates computerized gatherings, sheets, discourse sheets, microblogs, wikis, pics or video sharing, interpersonal interaction sites, social bookmarking, mashups and item assessments. As of late, social trade adventure has increased significant consideration in E-business world because of the internet based life transformation. Social trade has demonstrated a positive impact on the organizations' business when it is joined with the current e-plans of action. This paper gives a brief about the difficulties confronted while receiving social trade and approaches to stay away from them to expand your business.

articleTitle: Explosion Consequence Analysis for Military Targets Through Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: An Explosion Consequence Analysis (ECA) utilizes the explosives science to determine potential hazards to structures, people or other targets through objective procedures and scientific evidence. This paper proposes the implementation of support vector machines, a supervised machine learning algorithm in decision support for accurate and effective explosion consequence analysis. The model is trained over data obtained from United Nations SaferGuard tool and incorporates the consequence analysis of five military target types, namely, light and heavy armour, troops in bunkers and in open, and parked aircrafts. A validation accuracy of 97.5% has been obtained through the implementation of support vector machines with a cubic kernel and the model has been trained through the MATLAB classification learner App. This work adds to the body of evidence that machine learning techniques can be implemented to design accurate artificial intelligence decision support and expert systems for both military and civilian applications.

articleTitle: Impact Assessment of Digital Marketing Tools Application in Rural Homestays: A Case Study of Kullu District
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Homestay tourism is predominantly dependent on marketing. Conventionally, promotion of rural homestays has been done through word of mouth; though with technology advancements, homestay entrepreneurs are using various forms of digital marketing tools for business growth and development. This paper aims to examine the behavior of homestay owners in adoption and usage of digital marketing for promotion of homestays in rural areas of Kullu District of Himachal Pradesh, India, through a widely accepted framework known as Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), that forecasts estimation on voluntary usage and adoption of technology (Digital Marketing). Data has been collected through questionnaire method from 100 rural homestay entrepreneur in Kullu District. The study analyses various digital marketing techniques practiced by rural homestay entrepreneurs in the study region. The author found that online accommodation booking portals was the most preferred means of digital marketing followed by social media platforms. The result shows that social media too has a significant role in business development of homestays. It has also been found that digital marketing plays relatively a vital role in business development as well as improves brand image of homestays.

articleTitle: Standalone Hybrid Renewable Energy DC Grid System with Optimal Energy Management For AC Load Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper a hybrid DC micro grid standalone grid system is adopted with four sources (PVA, BESS, Super capacitor and fuel cell) for operating an AC load even during environmental disturbances. An optimal energy management scheme is implied on the grid system for better power sharing capability. The energy management scheme controls the buck & boost converters power electronic devices connected to sources for DC voltage stability. The modelling of the proposed system is designed in MATLAB Simulink software with graphical representations with time domain analysis for different operating conditions.

articleTitle: Medical Image Segmentation Techniques and Their Relevance in Contemporary Imaging
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Image segmentation is a method where the image is partitioned into multiple segments. Segmentation of the image is typically used for locating objects and boundaries in images and produces a set of segments that include the entire image or a series of contours drawn from the image together. Similarly, Medical Image Segmentation focusses on the automated or semi-automatic method of detecting boundaries within a 2D or 3D image. However, the major problem with segmenting the medical image is the high variability in medical images, to overcome which various segmentation techniques may be applied on these images. This paper presents the two most effective segmentation techniques i.e. fuzzy c means clustering and ant colony optimisation-canny on 3D CT scan of human body parts which further shows a comparative analysis of entropy values of the resultant images, with FCM providing drastic rise in the values. This may be highly useful to the medical practitioners for better understanding and visualisation of the images to provide effective diagnosis of the disease.

articleTitle: Contrast Enhancement for Color Dermascopy Images using Equalization based on Luminosity
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Contrast Enhancement is one of the crucial and important pre-processing steps. This method is applied to improve the perceiving quality of the image. In this paper we have proposed a method to preserve the details of an image while adjusting luminosity of the image. The main benefit of this method is that this can be applied in colored skin lesion image and while contrasting process is applied the details will not be lost. To study the success of the proposed system, the entropies of the test input images are compared with the entropies of the enhanced image.

articleTitle: Aerial War Game Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: War gaming is a tool to enhance human decision-making acumen during actual war time. War games are analytic games that simulate warfare at the tactical, operational or strategic level. They are used to analyze war fighting concepts, train and prepare commanders and subordinates, explore scenarios and evaluate how planning affects outcomes. Such simulations are very useful to develop tactical, strategic and doctrinal solutions. It also provides the participants with insight into decision making process and stress management. Our paper presents a framework that supports an aerial war game simulation in which two opposing forces (red and blue) participate and follow rules and strategies depicting an actual or real life situation. War is emulated and commanders and other officers perform war duties without any troops involved in this training. Our paper presents a proposal of aerial warfare training through simulation and discusses the nature of war gaming, its uses, underlying architecture and the functional modules visualized with their roles, game design i.e. the various stages into which the whole war game has been split and explains the states of the missions being planned by teams to accomplish the objectives given to them. Also, the paper addresses the implementation level details and overview of future scope visualized. This aerial war game solution is developed using java API's for 3D based GIS display, QT and Oracle 11g.

Author Keywords: Unit (one or group of aircrafts with associated resources)

articleTitle: IOT Based Solution for Waste Management: A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Careless throwing of waste material onto the roads is a common scenario to be found in our day to day life, this leads to an unhygienic environment around us. As garbage on the roads and public places are increasing day by day this can result in different type of diseases and standard of living will be degraded in future. Thus to overcome these problems some efficient system should be developed using IOT as its scope is increasing day by day. Various methods and design are available at present having both advantages and disadvantages. This paper provides a summarization of various applications of IOT solutions and technologies used in the field of Public Welfare and Hygiene.

articleTitle: Multiple Factor Authentication as a Security Measure in Credit Card Fraud
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cyber-crime is not a recent crime as it began in the year 1820 and started catching people's attention by the year 2000. Due to the increase in cyber-crime, there is a huge demand for cyber-security, and organizations feel the need to protect themselves from any kind of attack, to keep their image and reputation clear and above all to protect users ' confidential information and sensitive data. People are losing a lot in terms of data, privacy as well as financial. In this paper, we will talk about credit/debit card fraud and see how multiple-factor authentication as a security measure can be helpful to reduce this crime.

articleTitle: FFANN Weight Initialization: A New Method
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper a new weight initialization scheme is proposed. The proposed scheme, distributes the biases / thresholds at a equal intervals in an interval ( - λ, λ); while the weights are distributed uniformly in the same interval. The value of the λ is chosen such that the expected value of the net inputs is 0 while the variance is 1. On a set of 10 tasks (5 function approximation and 5 real life benchmark regression tasks), the proposed weight initialization routine was compared to three existing weight initialization routine. From the results obtained we may infer that the proposed weight initialization is almost always better than these three existing routines and is never worse on the basis of generalization performance (result over the test data set).

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Smart Interiors - Colours, Lighting and Domotics
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Colour and lighting plays an important role in an interior space by visually focusing out different elements like furniture and accessories in an interior space. Home automation systems (Domotics) are smart technologies to control indoor environment systems, lighting systems, entertainment systems and other appliances to increase comfort to the end user. This paper discusses about influence of lighting on interior colours through automation system around the globe. The study concentrates on how lighting and colour scheme can enhance the overall design and comfort of an interior space with use of home automation systems. Through this study, an effort was made to discuss importance and effectiveness of lighting and colour in creating a positive vibe in an interior space. This is further enhanced with help of home automation technology by creating contrast between colour systems, lighting systems and between warm and cold colours in an interior space. The findings will help designers to plan through on how to design an interior space using lighting and colour schemes to enhance an interior space visually with help of smart technology.

articleTitle: Characterization and Estimation of Odd-Lomax Lindley Distribution
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, Lindley Distribution (LD) has been expanded using member of T-X family. The new model has been named as Odd Lomax Lindley Distribution. Various statistical properties of the model has been studied. The method of Maximum Likelihood estimation (MLE) has been used to estimate the parameters. The proposed distribution offers more flexibility and has a variety of shapes for density function. To confirm the usefulness of the model, the model is subjected to two data sets which confirms it as a better fit when compared with other lifetime models.

articleTitle: Enterprise Virtual Desktop Infrastructure Architecture on OpenStack Cloud with Lightweight Directory Access Protocol
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) is a Virtualized Technology that hosts the user's desktop at Datacenter Server. OpenStack is the most successful opensource enterprise cloud platform. Cloud-based VDI, also known as “Desktop as a Service” or DaaS, increases utilization of Datacenter infrastructure, provides high elasticity, increases service diversity, and improves scalability. It also allows for prioritizing delivering value, give the choices to use a wide range of hypervisor/storage/network. In this paper, an architecture proposed that comprises three major components that are, hypervisor, connection broker, and display protocol for enterprise-level VDI on OpenStack. The hypervisor used to host many virtual machines on a single hardware. Connection broker used for configuring, inventorying, provisioning, and centralized management of desktops and display protocol allows users to view the desktop that hosted at Datacenter. Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) used for user authentication and authorization for desktops. In the paper, we explore the architecture design and implementation of the VDI system on OpenStack and verifies the experiment results.

articleTitle: Gateway Selection Scheme for MANET to Internet Connectivity: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Mobile ad hoc network (MANET) is an accumulation of mobile nodes that conFigure themselves, forms momentary network dynamically and communicate with each other. The most significant problem is to find the link which connects MANET to Internet. A Gateway is mobile nodes which act as an interface between MANET and Internet to enhance their coverage and connectivity; it has knowledge about both infrastructure and infrastructure less network. Gateway selection is most significant technique to link these types of networks which should be in steady state to guaranty best services for MANET and Internet availability. The main challenge for integration of MANET and Internet is gateway discovery and gateway selection. This paper presents a survey of various developing approach for selection of gateway which are used in MANET to Internet communication. A comparative analysis is also provided to summarize the survey.

articleTitle: Ripple Free AC-DC Converter with PID Controlled Power Decoupling Method
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper work includes the idea of power decoupling. The A.C. D.C. converter is delivered through the ac mains supply. For a single-phase ac supply system with unity power factor (pf.), the input side current is sinusoidal in nature and within phase along with the voltage signal of the A.C. source supply. The input side power supply is decoupled from D.C. signal component and an alternating current power supply with a frequency double of the line power frequency. To withstand a persistent output side power supply, a power controller consuming feedback from PID system is generally presented to compute error in undue power segments between two cycles and regulate the voltage at the feedback signal from the load device on the remaining time of cycle periods. Using such scheme the output side of the power adaptation circuit system can be kept persistent. In real time small ripple offerings on the output side voltage. Consequently, the output side filter capacitor requirement is successfully minimized.

articleTitle: Analysis of Communication Satellite Array for Optimal Global Coverage on Mars
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Human-driven planetary missions rely primarily on efficient communication within the mission base and Earth. Until now, for maintaining contact with Earth, either Martian robotic explorers, consisting of orbiter or another spacecraft, have been used. For a manned mission, reliance over one spacecraft, for communication, can be catastrophic in case of a single-point failure. Satellite constellation delivering 24-hour round the clock surveillance and communication would be the ideal scenario. Knowing the fact that the nearest medical facility is 55 million kilometers, such a satellite constellation communication array will deliver nonstop monitoring which will be paramount in the safety of the astronauts [1]. Research presented in this paper focuses on the assessment of establishing a communication satellite array in Martian orbit for optimal global coverage, along with different configuration types for such array. Results obtained demonstrated that the simplest optimal array design comprises of 6 satellites in 45° inclined 2 satellite orbits.

articleTitle: Reckoning of Newborn M-Sets with Their Complex Nature via Fixed Point Iteration
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In recent times, charismatic nature of Fractals and the study of their aspects are fascinating and thoughtprovoking concepts of research in the field of mathematics and without the notions of Mandelbrot and Julia sets we can’t image the fractal theory. This paper examines the various newborn M-sets (Mandelbrot sets) for the complex general polynomial $z^{n}+C$ for $n\geq 2$ in GK-orbit. The main focus of this paper is to generate new Mandelbrot sets for above said polynomial and Figure out their mathematical tendencies.

articleTitle: H-LSTM Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval in Code-Mixed Social Media Text
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The contents of social media consists of mixed script information and from these type of sources one can extract temporal information. The temporal contents are difficult to be processed by any machine. The challenge here is to retrieve temporal domain information used by the users for expressing their interests on any issue. The work outlines the comparative study of different approaches of temporal data retrieval in transliterated domain. A novel handcrafted rule based technique is applied which accepts input in mixed script format and on the basis of illustrated rules, the system is suppose to extract temporal expressions from the sentence. The evaluation measures use rule-based approach validations along with the evaluations based on statistical measures. To further validate the results a voting technique is applied that selects the most valid and suitable temporal tag for that word. The experimental results suggests that the voting method performs applied here gives the best result in context to accurate temporal tagging.

articleTitle: Designing Ontology for Massive Open Online Courses using Protégé
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Aimed at the problem of dropout in massive open online courses, this research work addresses the challenges and attributes of attrition. It investigates various factors to increase the effectiveness and efficiency in mooc platforms. The issue is not only interaction with the instructor but the necessity to create a social environment. The semantic web is an elongation of the present web that facilitates the meaning of information rather than syntax of the distinct vocabularies to the people and computers. The fundamental technique of semantic web mining is ontology. We have proposed semantic web mining by designing ontology for mooc platforms that can allow different mooc platforms to interact and create social environment for their users.

articleTitle: Analysis of the 1997 Chandmari Landslide, India, and Technology-enabled Risk Reduction
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Chandmari Hill lies in Gangtok City, Sikkim State, and is part of the Inner Himalayas. The hill has seen several landslides in the past, mostly during the monsoons. The region also experiences active seismicity which compounds the problem of slope instability. Since landslide activity was first recorded in Chandmari in 1966, there have been at least nine slides; the largest event was the 1997 rock and debris slide which resulted in eight fatalities and damaged several buildings and vehicles. We visited Chandmari in 2015 and carried out walkover surveys and analyzed soil and rock we collected from in and around the 1997 slide zone. Electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) studies were conducted to estimate subsurface conditions, and computational software was used to perform slope stability analyses. Our findings indicated that the slope continues to be unstable and that it is necessary to monitor the hill until comprehensive efforts to stabilize the hill are undertaken. We have deployed a wireless sensor networkbased landslide monitoring system at Chandmari. This paper demonstrates the value of technology in landslide risk mitigation.

articleTitle: Use of Distinct Parts of Moringa Oleifera in Domestic Wastewater Treatment (An Analogous Study)
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Moringa oleifera is a tree variety native to India and is a highly valued plant, distributed throughout tropics and subtropics. Almost all parts of this plant are being consumed as food and have medicinal applications. Wastewater treatment is also an important aspect of M. oleifera. Current study aims to evaluate the effects of M. oleifera seeds with oil, de-oiled and leaves on the wastewater treatment process. When water extract of all three components was applied to wastewater, it was seen that 99.2% and 99% reduction in turbidity was there in case of oiled and de-oiled seeds at the applied coagulant concentration of 2% and 1% respectively. Lowering up to 96.8% and 96.2% in suspended solids was also observed at the same applied dose. No raise in DO values were noticed in both cases. However, a slight reduction of 12.5% and 16.6% in BOD values were there at 1% applied concentration of stock solution for both oiled and de-oiled seeds. Reduction in COD was only observed in case of de-oiled seeds which was up to 25.3% at applied concentration of 1.5%. No effect on ammoniacal nitrogen was seen after application of all three coagulants in wastewater but nitrate nitrogen decreased uto 50.3% in case of oiled seeds and 51.6% in case of de-oiled seeds at applied concentration of 1.5% for both the cases. Also, no alteration in pH was seen which makes M. oleifera a suitable coagulant as no post-treatment is required. Whereas, in the case of M. oleifera leaves, no positive results were obtained in any of the parameters tested.

articleTitle: Bionic Eye - A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Blindness is a devastating disease which can happen due to various reasons such as due to retinitis pigmentosa (RP) and many other age-related macular degenerations (AMD). In this kind of disease, the photoreceptor cells gets degenerated and damages the retina and due to which a person losses his vision power. Therefore, bionic eye plays a vital part by restoring the vision. Technologies that are involved in bionic eyes are-multiple unit artificial retina chip system (MARC), artificial silicon retina system (ASR), ARGUS II, MIT HARVARD device. Holographic technology is used by which a person can again live a new life independently. This method take place through a small surgery replacing complicated surgeries. An advancement in the present research can be done by improving the technology is described in this paper. The quality of images to the bionic eye will be more clear by increasing the number of electrodes in the retinal implant. Platinum and iridium are currently used for implants but these metals deteriorates within 5 to 10 years. Instead of these metals if diamond device are implanted inside the eye then it will not deteriorate.

articleTitle: A Multi-decision Making DAQ System for Integrated Renewable Energy Sources at the End User Facility
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Energy systems are an inevitable part of the modern society. But, in today’s time, when the conventional sources of power generation are causing irreversible damage to the Earth and are the major cause of global warming, renewable energy sources come to the rescue. Data-acquisition system is being used in this hardware model for collect the voltage and current values from the generation as well as load side to perform power scheduling and optimization. A novel approach of integrating IoT with the hardware has been implemented. In this paper, a hardware model of Intelligent DAQ system for RES management has been presented. Three sources of renewable energy, i.e. hydro, wind and solar are used to provide electric power. This ensures uninterruptible power supply. The controller performs data-acquisition by integrating all the measuring and controlling input/output devices. Relay is used as a switching device to perform load scheduling in an accurate and cost-effective way. This system ensures that there is no power wastage and is cost effective and small in size.

articleTitle: Computation of Newbom J-Sets via Fixed Point Iteration and Their Complex Nature
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Recent days, Fractals, superfractals and examination of their dynamic nature are interesting and important notions of research in the field of Mathematics. In Fractal theory, Julia sets and Mandelbrot sets are two remarkable concepts for the researchers with many practical applications. This paper explores the various newborn J-sets (Julia sets) for the complex polynomial, $z^{n}+c, n\geq 2$ in GK-orbit. The main centre of point of this research paper is to originate new J-sets (Julia sets) with the understanding of their mathematical characteristics.

articleTitle: Deterministic and Stochastic Models-Population Growth Models Population Models
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The country needs to plan its present as well as future activities for the development of the country to grow socially as well as economically. For this planning, population projection provides the estimated population. Population directly depends on the number of births, deaths, and migration, so time-to-time determination is required. Mathematical analysis has been done for showing the rapid growth population. Deterministic and Stochastic models are considered because of the data available. The study shows the growth of the population with the help of mathematical models graphically. It can integrate for different investigations, assessment of the relative of different sorts of planning/project impacts, and supporting management decisions that put limited resources in redressing venture impacts that considerably impact the population.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of ASH (Advance Smart Healthcare) System: A Review Model
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In worldwide, CSD (cardiovascular disease) has become a leading cause of death. So that the detection or identification of CSD in early stages of patients became most challenging problem. IoT (Internet of Things) plays a vital role in modern medical field. The goal of this paper is to design an ASH (Advance Smart Healthcare) system which comprises of Electrocardiogram (ECG), Pulse rate, Blood pressure (BP), Body temperature etc., by resort of IoT with support of hardware and software. In this paper the main work is an overview of research on employment of ECG, feature extraction and algorithms of ECG and technologies used in health monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Security & Privacy Model for Work from Home Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The outbreak of novel corona-virus pandemic has caused the entire world to initiate a total lockdown and thus, affecting the businesses and other economic activities thus, as a work around several organizations are now capitalizing the work from home paradigm that allows them to continue with their economic activities with certain limitations. However, such a widespread use of the above mentioned paradigm has risked the privacy and security of the underlying computer resources even more. Work from home (WFH) is indeed the need of the hour but is full of loopholes which can be exploited further by those having malicious intentions and when a huge population of the world is following such a paradigm then the threat becomes even more serious. The underlying project aims propose a cyber security model for the work from home paradigm to make it relatively secure. Just like the Biba and Bell-LaPadula models which have been used as a basis for many security practices in general, this project proposes a similar model but specifically meant for the WFH practice as following this paradigm doesn't generally involve a lot of people as compared to the traditional on-site working but the risk surprisingly is more as individuals tend to avoid security practices whilst following `at home' ideology. The model suggests various practices and steps to be taken in order to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the data with a focus on cyber hygiene.

articleTitle: Analytical Approach towards Electrocardiogram Signal using Machine Learning and Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the era of digitalization, dependency on smart devices is increasing due to its promptness and accuracy. Image processing is the biggest challenge in coping with the data flood and duplication from such devices. Every image has certain features and properties like pixels, colour, and lines which can be used to extract valuable information. This paper presents a survey about the information that we get by analysing of Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. The different age group has different rhythm of the heartbeat (ECG) and heart problems such as arrhythmia, high blood pressure, etc. are reviewed. For the diagnosis of cardiac diseases, accuracy in the ECG signal is highly regarded as the most important factor. It is very challenging to find better accuracy in a signal. This paper also discusses a detailed survey of classification through different machine learning and data mining techniques and issues in input and output rhythm selection in ECG.

articleTitle: A New Generalization of Ailamujia Distribution with Real Life Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this study, a generalization of Ailamujia distribution namely Power-Lindley Ailamujia (PLA) distribution is proposed. Some statistical properties of the proposed model are discussed. The proposed distribution is more flexible and has increasing, reverse J and bathtub hazard rates. The parameters are estimated by the method of maximum likelihood estimation (MLE). Application and simulation are performed to validate the usefulness of the proposed distribution and ML estimators.

articleTitle: An Efficient approach of NeuroHash and its Comparision with Cryptograhic Hash
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Hash characteristic is one of the fantastic thing in cryptology which may be applied to message authentication and Digital Signature. There are numerous cryptographic Hash functions, for example, MD4, MD5, SHA-I SHA-2 mentioned by complicated techniques of multi-spherical cycles. As of overdue a portion of the shortcomings of those hash functions has been located as: 1. MD5 can be cracked thru collision attack. 2. SHA -1 is also now not secure to collision attack.In the proposed Scheme, A newly created hash function has been applied the XOR characteristic at the plaintext block previously preparing it into neural structures for computing message convolution and use of grey code concept on produced hash code-Both together give extra protection to the cryptographic framework. So studies and description of Secure and powerful hash function is required. For age of any other hash feature the wonder of neural synchronization and mutual gaining knowledge of is applied. A tenderfoot hash calculation has been evolved in mild of four layer feed forward system piecewise linear chaotic map and broke down towards the cryptographic hash capabilities.

articleTitle: Change Detection using Relative Radiometric Correction on Air Field Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper focusses on improving the results of change detection between two satellite images of the same place taken at different times. Some of the primary challenges faced in change detection lies in overcoming the unregistered dataset, disturbances introduced due to air borne sensors and diverse atmospheric conditions such as lighting, cloud shadows and atmosphere haziness. To overcome the above challenges an additional step of relative radiometric correction has been added, before performing change detection. The results derived have been quantified in the form of percentage of change in image. Finally, the changes have been visually interpreted, for analysing the correctness and accuracy of results.

articleTitle: Reliability Function Evaluation for Binary Switching System
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Although many kinds of methods have been used for the evaluation of reliability of switching system that are proved to be efficient, but this paper deals with the universal generating function which is being utilized for calculating reliability of binary switching system having eight independent identically distributed elements which are connected in series and parallel manner. In the end of the paper, a numerical example has been mentioned to give a better understanding.

articleTitle: Nanotechnology in Iron Deficiency Anemia: A review
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Anemia has become the most common and wide spread disease among the diverse age groups in the population in which iron-deficiency has emerged not only as the main cause of anemia but also lethal if not treated with caution. To address the growing concern of this disease World Health Organization has launched global nutrition target 2025 which aims to reduce the anemia in the population by 50%. This has not been possible with conventional therapeutics therefore this review article aims to summarize all the different conventional methods and provide a new aspect of implementing nanotechnology to treat anemia thus potentially aid in reducing the anemic population and meeting the global nutrition target 2025.

articleTitle: Exploration of Factors Affecting Adoption of Digital Wallet Among Indian Domestic Tourist: Study of Trust and Security Perception
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research study examines the factors affecting digital wallet adoption among Indian domestic tourist with specific reference to their perception of trust, security and factors of technology acceptance model (TAM).This study identified 15 variables from TAM including variables related to trust and security for the understanding of degree of digital wallet adoption among Indian domestic tourist. Exploratory factor analysis was used to identify the key determinants of digital wallet adoption. Convenient sampling technique is used to gather response from 118 domestic tourists who visited different places at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.The results of exploratory factor analysis confirm five factors. An extended research can be done on the same topic by including foreign tourist and by covering prominent destinations across various districts in Uttar Pradesh, India.This research paper identifies significant factors that play important role in the adoption of digital wallet among domestic tourist. The valuable contribution of this research can observed in the potential application of identified factors to develop a model for further study of how trust and security affect the adoption of digital wallet among tourists.

articleTitle: Cyber Physical Systems-Implications and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cyber physical systems are a topic of utmost interest and curiosity in the recent days. But at the same time the security threats and safety concerns are also being highlighted. Underway progresses which are being made on a regular basis in the field of science and technology improves relationship between physical and computational elements by using intellectual ways which increase the efficiency, reliability, adaptability, functionality, safety, usability and autonomy of the cyber physical systems drastically. The process of remodeling physical system into a cyber physical system is an ongoing thing which is completed by imbibing intelligence into the physical systems. This transformation can be considerably used for the welfare of the environment and the society by revamping the quality of life, convenience and comfort of the humans, even for minimizing depletion of environmental assets and bringing down ecological impacts. With all the fast paced advancements being made in this field, the security and safety are a huge concern. In this paper, we talk about the implications of cyber physical systems and its smart utilities as well as discuss the challenges and the security threats faced in cyber physical systems.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Compact Frequency Selective Surface with Multiple Resonant Frequencies using Layered Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, a stop band frequency selective surface (FSS) is proposed involving square patch. This square patch consists of a cut section of circular and rectangular shapes. The resultant slotted square patch have the capability to resonate at four frequencies at 3.36 GHz, 4.96GHz, 7.28GHz and 9.24GHz respectively. The design is compact as reduction in area by 88.7%, 75.4%,46.9% and 14.58% is achieved. Experimental results are matched with the analytical modelling and validated with simulation results. Simulation is done using Ansoft HFSS EM simulation tool while experimental set up used an Agilent Technologies vector network analyzer. Implementation of Back Propagation algorithm is included in this work which also validate the experimental resonant frequency values.

articleTitle: Reliability and Profit Evaluation of Textile Industry with Exponential Failure Time Distribution and Different Repair Strategies
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Better management of the systems, reducing failures, enhancing reliability and availability, minimizing operational and maintenance costs are still challenging fields for industries. In this study, an attempt has been made to examine the profit behaviour of Textile Industry with single server subject to priority of a vital unit. The System consists of three non-identical units viz, Spinning (S), Weaving (W), Colouring and Finishing (Cf). Initially unit (S) is in functional state whereas the other two units are in ideal state. System fails only if all the units are in down state. Single server is available in the system to carry out the repair activities. The units acts as fresh as new one after repairment of the failed unit. Reliability measures are examined and arbitrary values are given to different failure and repair parameters to define the performance of various reliability characteristics explicitly.

articleTitle: Validation of Vortex Tube Experimentally
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The analytical, numerical and experimental validation of a vortex tube has been carried out at various pressure ranging from 0 psi to 140 psi. The lowest temperature observed during the experiment was 280.3 K (7.15 C) at 52 psi, the highest temperature was observed at 317.4 K (44.25 C) at 120 psi and the maximum temperature difference obtained was around the pressure range of 49 to 55 psi.

articleTitle: Learning Automata Based Heuristics for Target Q-Coverage
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Coverage problem in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), deals with monitoring of targets in a certain given terrain. In dense network, targets are covered by redundant sensors at any span of time while achieving full coverage. It happens so because, sensor nodes are densely deployed. A network is called operational till all the targets are covered by at least a sensor in cover set. To extend network lifetime, one can schedule the sensor activity by alternating each sensor from active to sleep state and vice versa. Since network dynamics is changing with time, the proposed energy proficient scheduling algorithm follows learning automata which helps a sensing node to choose action state (active or sleep). The effectiveness of the suggested method is proved by carrying a set of simulations over various scenarios under different environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Cloudlet based Selection Strategy of Virtual Machine for Task Allocation in Multi-Cloudlet Environment using Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2020 8th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In recent times smart-phones used as a device for different computational activity. It has great processing capability with increasing number of core and CPU cycles. Instead of its good processing capability it suffers from inherent problem of battery usage and storage. Introducing smartphones cloud computing can leverage a better computing environment. Still, it suffers in respond time in case of latency sensitive application. In this paper, three stage task allocation optimization problem examined with integer linear programming. A comparison of task allocation strategy in different stage is tested and analyzed with performance gain of approximately 54% in terms of access latency.
